entries.title: Aven Colony
entries.definitive_edition: Aven Colony Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with Deluxe Edition content.

primary.version: Deluxe Edition / current Windows PC release with Cerulean Vale
primary.why: Aven Colony is a sci-fi city-builder released on Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One in 2017. The Deluxe Edition is the base game plus Cerulean Vale and soundtrack. The Expedition Update brought console versions content already available on Steam, so no console-exclusive gameplay route exists. Windows PC with Cerulean Vale is the preferred archive route because it offers the best capture/settings path and the clearest complete-content package.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC Deluxe Edition or install the base game plus Cerulean Vale. Console versions are valid alternatives after their content updates, but not the main archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster split was found. Cerulean Vale is the gameplay DLC to include; soundtrack is optional media.
